items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: I got to know him. ... I was affiliated with some of his relatives.

ctx.x: up too, I'm going to let you know. You played some parades for them sometimes?

Yeah. I played one on Carnival Eve. They parade around on Carnival Eve? Carnival Eve, yeah. That's the scene of the mayor from Pumetum that day. And they would like to have got it that Sunday, but there was too much other activity and there wouldn't be enough protection for them. So by being the other, they put it on that day. And they give a lot of different things. They got a hall now, they got a lot of activities coming up now. They got a lot of activities coming up now. They got a lot of activities coming up.…
Papa Jack. Well I told you he was before your time. He was over 90. He was 92.
